playerPromise: Read the room, build a shared rhythm, and turn one synchronized decision into a spectacular team payoff.

baselineModules.title: Name the Player Promise
baselineModules.application: The promise above rejects solo-only complexity and makes synchronized team payoff observable.

baselineModules.title: Model the Loop as Verbs
baselineModules.application: Move, collect, choose, bank, read, pulse, adapt.

baselineModules.title: Prototype the Risk, Not the Pitch
baselineModules.application: The playable slice tests whether collection plus synchronized timing is legible and satisfying.

baselineModules.title: Read Intent Before Exact Input
baselineModules.application: Movement accepts normalized vectors and pulse inputs are buffered briefly at the sync boundary.

baselineModules.title: Treat Camera as Gameplay
baselineModules.application: One fixed arena view always exposes players, core, beats, glitch telegraphs, score, and timer.

baselineModules.title: Make Gameplay State Authoritative
baselineModules.application: The Node host owns motion, collection, banking, hazards, pulse legality, score, and outcome.

baselineModules.title: Keep State Machines Coarse
baselineModules.application: Lobby, countdown, playing, and results are the only control regimes.

baselineModules.title: Solve Contacts After Base Motion
baselineModules.application: Players move first, then arena bounds, beat contacts, core banking, and hazard contacts resolve.

baselineModules.title: Separate Attack Intent, Active Hit, and Result
baselineModules.application: Every pulse records intent, authorization, and resolved surge contribution as separate ledger stages.

baselineModules.title: Build with a Metric Kit
baselineModules.application: Arena, core, player, beat, hazard, speed, and contact metrics live in one frozen contract.

baselineModules.title: Author Systems Before Volume
baselineModules.application: One arena recombines carry risk, banking, synchronization, hazards, AI, and score without content sprawl.

baselineModules.title: Separate Decision from Execution
baselineModules.application: AI chooses an intent in one function and executes through the same semantic action gate.

baselineModules.title: Show Consequence Before Commitment
baselineModules.application: Glitches telegraph before becoming active and the core announces the pulse window before commitment.

baselineModules.title: Balance Around Decisions, Not Equal Numbers
baselineModules.application: Safe sparks, valuable volatile beats, carry capacity, movement cost, and bank timing create distinct choices.

baselineModules.title: Assign a Sensory Hierarchy
baselineModules.application: Critical sync and hazard events use text, shape, light, motion, and optional audio/haptics.

baselineModules.title: Define Asset Contracts
baselineModules.application: Procedural visual types declare stable shape, color, size, label, and role mappings.

baselineModules.title: Set Frame-Time Budgets in Milliseconds
baselineModules.application: The client displays measured render cost against a 16.7 ms frame target.

baselineModules.title: Separate Domain Logic from Engine Glue
baselineModules.application: Pure UMD game-core rules are separate from HTTP and Canvas adapters.

baselineModules.title: Choose Authority Explicitly
baselineModules.application: Manifest, server, API, and UI all name the host as authority; clients send intentions only.

baselineModules.title: Build a Test Pyramid for Games
baselineModules.application: Pure-rule assertions, HTTP lifecycle integration, package verification, and live visual journey cover different risks.

authority: Prototype design record. It guides implementation but does not promote playtest claims to canon.
